title: Generative product design Kansei mapping by an integrated temporal convolutional network-transformer-gated recurrent unit and stable diffusion model
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: This study proposes a generative Kansei mapping framework integrating KE with a TCN-Transformer-GRU model to design ceramic incense burners. It combines cloud model-entropy weight method for emotional vocabulary weighting, and uses SDM for visual design generation. Human evaluations include surveys and eye-tracking experiments.
